name: Geocoder
description: Parses pager messages for addresses, geocodes them via Nominatim, stores results, and pushes to the public map service.

config.name: nominatimSource
config.label: Nominatim Source
config.description: Choose public Nominatim or a private/self-hosted instance

config.name: nominatimUrl
config.label: Nominatim URL
config.description: Nominatim API endpoint. Pre-filled for public; enter your private instance URL here.

config.name: rateLimitMs
config.label: Rate Limit (ms)
config.description: Minimum delay between Nominatim requests (recommended: 1100ms = 1 request/sec per Nominatim ToS)

config.name: userAgent
config.label: User Agent
config.description: User-Agent header for Nominatim requests (required by OSM Nominatim usage policy)

config.name: mapPushUrl
config.label: Map Push URL
config.description: URL of the public map push endpoint (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/push-call)

config.name: mapApiKey
config.label: Map API Key
config.description: Shared secret for push authentication (must match PUBLIC_MAP_API_KEY in the map service's .env)

config.name: bulkMode
config.label: Bulk Mode
config.description: When enabled, limits to 4 requests/min (Nominatim bulk policy). Turn off for real-time 1 req/sec interactive mode.

config.name: dedupEnable
config.label: Enable Deduplication
config.description: Skip map inserts for duplicate addresses + messages within the configured window

config.name: dedupWindowMinutes
config.label: Dedup Window (minutes)
config.description: Time window for deduplication. Same address + message within this window is skipped. Default: 15 minutes.

aliasConfig.name: enable
aliasConfig.label: Enable Geocoding
aliasConfig.description: Enable geocoding for messages matching this alias
